info.title: Vale REST API
info.summary: JSON REST API for Vale CMS content, shop, orders, media and newsletter data.
info.description:
All operations live under `/api/v1` and use Bearer token authentication, except the operations marked with an empty `security` list (health, this specification and the marketplace feeds).

Tokens are created in **Admin → Settings → Advanced → API Tokens** and carry a comma-separated list of abilities, or `*` for everything. Abilities follow the `verb:resource` convention (`read:posts`, `write:products`, `delete:subscribers`).

The ability an operation needs is declared in the `x-vale-abilities` extension. An empty array means any valid token is enough (`security` still applies); an empty `security` array means the operation is public.

Unpublished content (`draft`, `scheduled`, `expired`, `archived`, `trash` and the `all` list filter) additionally requires the endpoint's write ability, so a read-only token only ever sees publicly readable content.

This document is the source of truth for tooling (MCP servers, client generators, Postman). `tests/Unit/Api/OpenApiSpecTest.php` fails whenever `routes/api.php` and this file drift apart.

servers.description: Current installation. Prefix the paths below with your site URL (and with APP_BASE_PATH when Vale runs in a subdirectory).

tags.name: System
tags.description: Health, specification and public data feeds.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Shop catalog, categories and product feeds.

get.description: Plain mode is a static liveness proof and never touches the database. `deep=1` additionally verifies the database, `storage/` and `storage/cache/` and answers `503` with `status: degraded` when something is wrong. Deep mode is rate limited per IP (30 requests per 60 seconds) and returns `429` when exhausted.
Serves the specification used to generate clients, MCP tool definitions and API documentation. Public — no token required.

post.description: Fires `post.created` and, when the result is published, `post.published`.

get.description: Published and unlisted posts are returned for any token. Other statuses are returned only when the token also holds `write:posts`; trashed posts always answer `404`, so a read-only token cannot detect an unpublished post.

put.description: Partial payloads are supported: omitted fields keep their stored value. Fires `post.updated` (and `post.published` when the result is published).

delete.description: Permanently deletes the record and fires `post.deleted`.

get.description: Unpublished statuses follow the same rule as posts: the page is returned to a token holding `write:pages`, otherwise `404` (trashed pages are never returned).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name and SKU.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: `1` restricts the result to products inside an active sale window.

post.description: `name` is required; duplicate SKUs are rejected with `422`. Image values (featured image, gallery, variation image, download files) are imported into the media library and a provided-but-unimportable value fails with `422`. Fires `product.created`.

get.summary: Get a product by numeric ID
get.description: Use this to resolve an `order.items[].product_id` back to the product.

post.description: Returns the existing category (status `200`) when the slug is already taken.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Order number, billing name/email or coupon code.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Date or datetime — use for incremental sync.

post.description: Mirrors the admin *Create Order* screen. Catalog prices are resolved server-side and the total is always computed as `subtotal + shipping - discount`; it is never taken from the payload. Only offline payment methods are accepted. Creating the order in a paid status sets `paid_at`, fires `order.paid` and applies the same subscriber tagging as the admin panel.

get.description: Returns the safe subset: status, totals, payment method, timestamps, customer e-mail and line items. Billing address and payment tokens are never exposed.

put.description: Status transitions run the full admin side-effect chain (paid_at bookkeeping, coupon usage, download revocation, `order.status_changed` / `order.paid` / `order.reversed` / `order.shipped` events, subscriber tagging, subscription cancellation). Financial and address fields are protected and rejected with `422`.

get.description: Only `type=note` timeline entries are returned (system/event log rows are excluded).

post.description: The note appears in the admin order detail timeline with `added_by = API`. Maximum length is 5000 characters; a whitespace-only note is rejected.

delete.description: Only `type=note` entries can be deleted; system rows answer `404`.

post.description: Accepts a JSON body with `url` (downloaded, private/internal hosts blocked), a JSON body with `base64` (+ optional `name`), or a multipart request with one or more files in `files[]`. Admin upload limits and the mime whitelist apply.

base64.description: Data URI or bare base64 payload.

post.description: New subscribers are created in `pending` status (double opt-in). Set `skip_optin: true` to create them as `active` without the opt-in e-mail. Fires `subscriber.created`.

put.description: Partial payloads are supported. Setting `status` to `active` confirms the subscription.

get.description: Public when the feed is enabled in the shop settings; answers `404` when the shop is switched off.
Used by the admin GMC category picker. Requires a valid token but no specific ability.

bearerAuth.description: API token created in Admin → Settings → Advanced → API Tokens. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes and may carry an expiry date.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Items per page (maximum 100). Defaults to 15 for posts, pages and products, and to 30 for orders, media and subscribers.

ContentStatusFilter.name: status
ContentStatusFilter.description: One status, a comma-separated combination, or `all` (every status except `trash`). Defaults to `published`. Anything beyond `published` / `unlisted` (including `all`) requires the endpoint's write ability — a read-only token gets `403`. The applied filter is echoed as `meta.status`.

ProductStatusFilter.name: status
ProductStatusFilter.description: One status, a comma-separated combination, or `all` (every status except `trash`). Defaults to `published`. Anything beyond `published` / `unlisted` (including `all`) requires `write:products`.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the required ability.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, or its status is not readable with this token.

ErrorResponse.description: Request rejected with a single message.

status.description: The applied status filter (`all` when every status is included).

ContentWrite.description: All fields are optional on update; `title` is required on create.

slug.description: Generated from the title when omitted.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 or `Y-m-d H:i:s`. A future value marks the item as scheduled.

featured_image.description: Media ID, absolute https URL, or base64 data URI. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

categories.description: Category IDs; unknown IDs are dropped.

tags.description: Tag names; created automatically when they do not exist.

ProductWrite.description: `name` is required on create. Every other field is optional; on update omitted fields keep their stored value.

stock_status.description: Canonical values are `in_stock`, `out_of_stock`, `on_backorder`; WooCommerce spellings (`instock`, `onbackorder`, `notify`, …) are normalized.

featured_image.description: Media ID, absolute https URL, or base64 data. Unimportable values fail with `422`.

dimensions.description: String or `{length,width,height}`, normalized to `L x W x H`.

OrderCreate.description: Manual/offline order. Totals are computed server-side as `subtotal + shipping - discount` and are VAT-inclusive.

variation_id.description: Requires a product reference; unknown variations fail with `422`.

variation.description: Overrides the stored variation attributes for this line.

name.description: Required for custom lines without a product reference.

price.description: Required for custom lines; overrides the catalog price otherwise.

payment_method.description: Offline methods only; gateway-paid orders must be created by checkout.

note.description: Added to the order timeline as an API note.

notify_customer.description: Sends the tracking e-mail with the shipment update.

skip_optin.description: Create the subscriber as `active` and skip the opt-in e-mail.
